title: vamp pipeline
description: A vamp pipeline definition: name, optional inputs, and a list of stages forming a DAG.

cache.description: Pipeline-level opt-out: explicit false disables the content-addressed cache for every stage in the pipeline.

inputs.description: Map of pipeline-level input name -> spec, passed on the CLI as --input.

additionalProperties.description: Pipeline-level input passed on the CLI via --input.

default.description: Default value applied when --input <name> is omitted.

required.description: When true, the runner errors if the user doesn't pass --input <name>=...

type.description: Input value type. Phase 1 only supports "string".

name.description: Pipeline name; identifier-like, used in run dir names and pipeline.json.

stages.description: Ordered list of stages forming the pipeline DAG.

items.description: A single stage in the pipeline DAG.

assert.description: Optional response checks (webhook stages). Turns a webhook into a smoke-test probe: status_code, body_contains, body_not_contains, min_body_length are all validated against the response. Setting status_code overrides the default 2xx-required behaviour so tests can confirm a 401/4xx.

body_contains.description: Substrings that ALL must appear in the response body.

body_not_contains.description: Substrings that must NOT appear in the response body.

min_body_length.description: Minimum response body length in bytes. Catches 200 + empty body.

status_code.description: Exact HTTP status code required. Overrides the default 2xx check.

binary.description: Override the path to the piper or ffmpeg binary on $PATH.

body.description: Templated JSON body (webhook stages). Mutually exclusive with body_template_file.

body_template_file.description: Path to a body template file; rendered verbatim and sent as the request body.

cache.description: Per-stage opt-out: explicit false disables the content-addressed cache for this stage; absent inherits the pipeline default.

capability.description: Capability name resolved to a vibe profile via capabilities.yaml.

ffmpeg_args.description: Literal argv passed to ffmpeg (each entry template-rendered).

foreach.description: Fan-out descriptor: run this stage once per item of an upstream JSON-array output.

from.description: ID of the upstream stage whose JSON-array output drives the fan-out.

var.description: Template variable name bound to each item (defaults to "item").

headers.description: Flat map of header name -> templated value (webhook stages).

inputs.description: IDs of prior stages this stage depends on.

message.description: Approval prompt rendered to the operator (confirm stages).

output.description: Templated output path, relative to the run dir.

output_format.description: When "json", the runner validates the stage output parses as JSON.

parameters.description: Map of "<node_id>.<input_name>" -> templated value for comfyui workflows.

params.description: Extra fields merged into the chat-completion body (text stages only).

privacy.description: YouTube visibility: private, unlisted, or public.

prompt.description: Inline prompt template (text stages only). Mutually exclusive with prompt_file.

prompt_file.description: Path to a prompt template file, relative to the pipeline YAML's directory.

retry.description: Per-stage retry-with-exponential-backoff policy for transient executor failures.

max_attempts.description: Maximum number of attempts before giving up (>= 1).

retry_on_5xx.description: Deprecated alias for retry_on_transient. When true (the default) a 5xx response triggers the transient-error retry path. New pipelines should use retry_on_transient — it covers HTTP 429 too.

retry_on_transient.description: When true (the default) HTTP 429 (rate-limited) and HTTP 5xx responses trigger the transient-error retry path with exponential backoff. Replaces retry_on_5xx; mutually exclusive with that deprecated alias.

run_when.description: Gate the stage. Reserved keywords success (default) / failure / always inspect upstream status; any other value is a Go text/template expression that must render to one of true/yes/1 (run) or false/no/0/"" (skip).

tags.description: Fixed string list of YouTube tags.

text.description: Templated text fed to Piper on stdin (audio stages).

thumbnail.description: Optional template path to a thumbnail image (youtube stages).

video.description: Templated path to the MP4 to upload (youtube stages).

voices_dir.description: Override directory containing <voice>.onnx model files (audio stages).

workflow.description: Path to a ComfyUI workflow JSON, relative to the pipeline YAML (comfyui stages).
